description_en: Retrieves the list of entities that require disposition and the list of playbooks
description_zh: 获取需要被处置的实体列表与剧本列表
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem describe-dispose-and-playbook --entity-type ip --incident-uuid 85ea4241-798f-4684-a876-65d4f0c30000 --entity-uuid 85ea4241-798f-4684-a876-65d4f0c30000 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --role-type 1 --role-for 1130916744880000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDisposeAndPlaybook

parameters.help_en:
The entity type. Valid values:
- ip: IP address
- process: process
- file: file
parameters.help_zh:
实体类型。取值：
- ip：ip
- process：进程
- file：文件
parameters.name: entity_type

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 列表当前页号， 大于等于1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 列表每页条数， 最大不超过100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The view type. Valid values:

- 0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
- 1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the data management center of the threat analysis feature resides. Select the data management center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
- cn-hangzhou: Your assets reside in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).
- ap-southeast-1: Your assets reside in regions outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id
